Stay tuned for further updates on how these initiatives will shape the future of St. Johns County.

data.title: “We're exhausted, but the residents are counting on us.” - CUPE 4599 to hold information picket ahead of contract negotiations at Kensington Medical Center in Toronto
data.description: In Toronto's Kensington Market, the dedicated workers of CUPE 4599 at Kensington Health Long-Term Care and Hospice offer top-tier care to residents. Despite facing strenuous physical and mental demands, these workers faithfully attend to their duties each day, supporting some of the most fragile community members out of genuine concern. Unfortunately, the challenging environment with excessive workloads, elevated stress levels, and inadequate remuneration has led to a sharp rise in turnover within the facility. As contract discussions are currently ongoing, the local union is aiming to address these issues.
